summary: Ansible 9 removed the unmaintained cisco.nso, community.fortios, community.google, community.skydive and ngine_io.vultr collections and servicenow.servicenow (accidentally re-added in Ansible 8); all can still be installed with ansible-galaxy.
questions: How do I keep using servicenow.servicenow on Ansible 9?
Why was servicenow.servicenow back in Ansible 8?

answer_card.title: Install collections removed from Ansible 9
answer_card.answer_md:
These were removed from Ansible 9 but can still be installed manually:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install cisco.nso community.fortios community.google \
  community.skydive ngine_io.vultr servicenow.servicenow
```

`servicenow.servicenow` was removed in Ansible 7, accidentally re-added in 8, and removed again in 9.
